bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the disparity in model performance and benchmark representation between high-resource (e.g., English) and low-resource languages, utilizing resourcefulness tiers, Mean Pairwise Syntactic Distance (MPSD), and GramBank Feature Value Inclusion (GBI).

Reviewing multimodal benchmarks (such as MARVL, WorldCuisines, and CVQA) that evaluate models on cultural awareness using region-specific imagery and culturally grounded content to detect Western-centric or English-centric representation assumptions.
